notes.title: De-debug (and even better bees)
notes.notes: A very small update to remove debug data, making Hive feel like an actual game and not a developer sandbox. The worker be AI has also been improved slightly, with flying paths resolving more efficiently. There still may be some random bee issues, but this patch really helps with the flying path problems they had previously.

notes.title: Performance Improvements (Round 1!)
notes.notes:
This project is built in UE5, which is a very large engine with a lot of advanced features. By default, UE5's lighting and mesh settings have a high impact on performance on devices with low-power hardware. These settings have been reconfigured to better suit Hive, its gameplay atmosphere, and its target audience.

Players should see a decent performance increase even on Max graphics settings. Highest FPS can be achieved on Lite settings. The render distance setting will not impact FPS.
